        (function () {
            function getCookieValue(name) {
                var regex = new RegExp('(^| )' + name + '=([^;]+)');
                var match = document.cookie.match(regex);
                if (match) {
                    return decodeURIComponent(match[2]);
                }
            }

            /**
             * Checking whether marketing cookies consent is given.
             *
             * @return {Boolean}
             */
            function checkConsent() {
                // get consent by cookie consent groups
                const cookie = getCookieValue("OptanonConsent");
                const cookieVals = cookie ? cookie.split("&") : [];
                let consentGroups = "";

                for (let cv of cookieVals) {
                    if (cv.indexOf("groups") === 0) {
                        consentGroups = cv.substring("groups=".length);
                    }
                }

                const consent = {};
                // 1:1,2:0,3:1,4:0 for consent category and true/false
                if (consentGroups && consentGroups.indexOf(",") > 0) {
                    var groups = consentGroups.split(",");
                    for (let group of groups) {
                        let groupValues = group.split(":");
                        consent[groupValues[0]] = groupValues[1];
                    }
                }

                const consentValue = consent && consent[4] ? consent[4] : "0";
                return consentValue === '1';
            }

            // in case marketing cookie consent is given, hide the content until adobe launch script is loaded and
            // decides about the redirects/etc. As fallback content will be shown in 3 seconds
            if (checkConsent()) {
                const hideContent = document.getElementById('alloy-prehiding');
                if (hideContent && document.location.href.indexOf('adobe_authoring_enabled') === -1) {
                    hideContent.innerText = '.utils-page-fullheight { opacity: 0 !important; }';

                    setTimeout(function () {
                        if (hideContent.parentNode) {
                            hideContent.parentNode.removeChild(hideContent);
                        }
                    }, 3000);
                }
            }
        })();

    </script>

             <h2>What sets TeamViewer Remote apart?</h2>
            </div>

           <div class="benefitlist utils-half-spacing-bottom aem-GridColumn aem-GridColumn--default--12">
            <div class="cmp-benefitlist utils-gridGutter">
             <div class="title cmp-benefitlist__title">
              <div data-cmp-data-layer="{"title-b35ec9c2f0":{"@type":"teamviewer/components/tenants/website/_atoms/title","dc:title":"Security","xdm:linkURL":""}}" id="title-b35ec9c2f0" class="cmp-title">
               <h2 class="cmp-title__text">Security</h2>
              </div>
             </div>
             <ul class="cmp-benefitlist__list">
              <li class="cmp-benefitlist__benefit">Industry-leading security: Security pioneer BitSight Security Ratings ranks TeamViewer as Top 1% in the tech industry.</li>
              <li class="cmp-benefitlist__benefit">Secure remote sessions: The new way to connect. Create individual remote support sessions without the need to exchange passwords via phone, chat, or any other channel.</li>
              <li class="cmp-benefitlist__benefit">Connection origin detection: See where incoming connections are coming from before you start a remote session, and safeguard against malicious attacks.</li>
              <li class="cmp-benefitlist__benefit">Encryption: All TeamViewer connections are end-to-end encrypted. No one who shouldn’t can see the content of the connections, not even us.</li>
             </ul>
            </div>
           </div>
           <div class="benefitlist utils-half-spacing-bottom aem-GridColumn aem-GridColumn--default--12">

               <h2 class="cmp-title__text">Compatibility</h2>
              </div>
             </div>
             <ul class="cmp-benefitlist__list">
              <li class="cmp-benefitlist__benefit">Best OEM support: Benefit from remote access to all operating systems including any Android devices, regardless of the manufacturer, as well as screen sharing for iPhones and iPads.</li>
              <li class="cmp-benefitlist__benefit">Headless devices: No screen? No problem! Enjoy secure remote access to headless devices, including servers.</li>
             </ul>
            </div>
           </div>
           <div class="benefitlist aem-GridColumn aem-GridColumn--default--12">
            <div class="cmp-benefitlist utils-gridGutter">

               <h2 class="cmp-title__text">Performance</h2>
              </div>
             </div>
             <ul class="cmp-benefitlist__list">
              <li class="cmp-benefitlist__benefit">Fast file transfer: Our compression capabilities ensure secure and fast file transfer, even for large files.</li>
              <li class="cmp-benefitlist__benefit">Stable connections: Our global access network will ensure stable connections and the best possible transmission quality, even in environments with low internet bandwidth.</li>
              <li class="cmp-benefitlist__benefit">First-class user experience: Fast connection set-up, high transmission speeds, and superior picture quality ensure a seamless, immersive, and frustration-free support experience.</li>
             </ul>

        (function () {
            function getCookieValue(name) {
                var regex = new RegExp('(^| )' + name + '=([^;]+)');
                var match = document.cookie.match(regex);
                if (match) {
                    return decodeURIComponent(match[2]);
                }
            }

            /**
             * Checking whether marketing cookies consent is given.
             *
             * @return {Boolean}
             */
            function checkConsent() {
                // get consent by cookie consent groups
                const cookie = getCookieValue("OptanonConsent");
                const cookieVals = cookie ? cookie.split("&") : [];
                let consentGroups = "";

                for (let cv of cookieVals) {
                    if (cv.indexOf("groups") === 0) {
                        consentGroups = cv.substring("groups=".length);
                    }
                }

                const consent = {};
                // 1:1,2:0,3:1,4:0 for consent category and true/false
                if (consentGroups && consentGroups.indexOf(",") > 0) {
                    var groups = consentGroups.split(",");
                    for (let group of groups) {
                        let groupValues = group.split(":");
                        consent[groupValues[0]] = groupValues[1];
                    }
                }

                const consentValue = consent && consent[4] ? consent[4] : "0";
                return consentValue === '1';
            }

            // in case marketing cookie consent is given, hide the content until adobe launch script is loaded and
            // decides about the redirects/etc. As fallback content will be shown in 3 seconds
            if (checkConsent()) {
                const hideContent = document.getElementById('alloy-prehiding');
                if (hideContent && document.location.href.indexOf('adobe_authoring_enabled') === -1) {
                    hideContent.innerText = '.utils-page-fullheight { opacity: 0 !important; }';

                    setTimeout(function () {
                        if (hideContent.parentNode) {
                            hideContent.parentNode.removeChild(hideContent);
                        }
                    }, 3000);
                }
            }
        })();

                          <li>Auditability (audit log and API)</li>
                          <li>Premium 24-hour support available (SLA required)</li>
                         </ul>

mainEntity.name: How does TeamViewer's pricing model work?

acceptedAnswer.text: At TeamViewer, we offer our customers annual subscriptions, which are paid for and renewed on an annual basis.

mainEntity.name: Does every session participant need a paid license?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, only an expert needs a license. The connection that they are supporting does not require one.

mainEntity.name: What forms of payment do you accept?

acceptedAnswer.text: At TeamViewer we accept payment via Visa, Mastercard, American Express, JCB, and PayPal. Bank transfers are also accepted in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.

Use advanced TeamViewer AI to analyze data, from screenshots to error logs. Isolate faults, identify best practices, improve knowledge transfer, and resolve issues fast.

  • Tia: By querying our AI troubleshooting assistant, find faults and fix them fast, using natural language to get real-time, device-specific answers and insights.
  • Session Insights: Our AI-powered note-taker compiles a summary for each case, spots patterns, highlights insights—and more.

DEX Essentials helps IT teams stay ahead of issues with real-time visibility, actionable insights, and automated remediation across endpoints. By covering performance, applications, operating systems, security, and networking, it enables teams to proactively resolve issues, reduce manual effort, and maintain uptime—all without relying on large teams or complex toolsets.

mainEntity.name: What if I can’t find a license to suit my needs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our sales team are on hand to talk you through our bespoke packages.

mainEntity.name: How do I cancel my plan and license?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your subscription will automatically renew every 12 months unless you terminate your contract by submitting a support ticket or notifying us in text form, at least 28 days before the end of the initial term or any renewal term.

Pricing for the add-on licenses is calculated based on the number of endpoints, users, or storage you require. Volume discounts are available. Simply provide these details to understand the final price or, alternatively, reach out to us for a quote.
A concurrent connection is multiple sessions happening at the same time, also known as channels.
Managed devices are devices assigned to the company account and centrally managed within the company profile by the administrator.
Licensed users are individuals who are assigned to a specific license and can use that license to make connections.
An endpoint is a device connected to TeamViewer.

        (function () {
            function getCookieValue(name) {
                var regex = new RegExp('(^| )' + name + '=([^;]+)');
                var match = document.cookie.match(regex);
                if (match) {
                    return decodeURIComponent(match[2]);
                }
            }

            /**
             * Checking whether marketing cookies consent is given.
             *
             * @return {Boolean}
             */
            function checkConsent() {
                // get consent by cookie consent groups
                const cookie = getCookieValue("OptanonConsent");
                const cookieVals = cookie ? cookie.split("&") : [];
                let consentGroups = "";

                for (let cv of cookieVals) {
                    if (cv.indexOf("groups") === 0) {
                        consentGroups = cv.substring("groups=".length);
                    }
                }

                const consent = {};
                // 1:1,2:0,3:1,4:0 for consent category and true/false
                if (consentGroups && consentGroups.indexOf(",") > 0) {
                    var groups = consentGroups.split(",");
                    for (let group of groups) {
                        let groupValues = group.split(":");
                        consent[groupValues[0]] = groupValues[1];
                    }
                }

                const consentValue = consent && consent[4] ? consent[4] : "0";
                return consentValue === '1';
            }

            // in case marketing cookie consent is given, hide the content until adobe launch script is loaded and
            // decides about the redirects/etc. As fallback content will be shown in 3 seconds
            if (checkConsent()) {
                const hideContent = document.getElementById('alloy-prehiding');
                if (hideContent && document.location.href.indexOf('adobe_authoring_enabled') === -1) {
                    hideContent.innerText = '.utils-page-fullheight { opacity: 0 !important; }';

                    setTimeout(function () {
                        if (hideContent.parentNode) {
                            hideContent.parentNode.removeChild(hideContent);
                        }
                    }, 3000);
                }
            }

               <p>PortForward develops smart ICT solutions to improve overall collaboration within the port and its workers, e.g. for finetuning freight flows.   <script>
        (function () {
            function getCookieValue(name) {
                var regex = new RegExp('(^| )' + name + '=([^;]+)');
                var match = document.cookie.match(regex);
                if (match) {
                    return decodeURIComponent(match[2]);
                }
            }

            /**
             * Checking whether marketing cookies consent is given.
             *
             * @return {Boolean}
             */
            function checkConsent() {
                // get consent by cookie consent groups
                const cookie = getCookieValue("OptanonConsent");
                const cookieVals = cookie ? cookie.split("&") : [];
                let consentGroups = "";

                for (let cv of cookieVals) {
                    if (cv.indexOf("groups") === 0) {
                        consentGroups = cv.substring("groups=".length);
                    }
                }

                const consent = {};
                // 1:1,2:0,3:1,4:0 for consent category and true/false
                if (consentGroups && consentGroups.indexOf(",") > 0) {
                    var groups = consentGroups.split(",");
                    for (let group of groups) {
                        let groupValues = group.split(":");
                        consent[groupValues[0]] = groupValues[1];
                    }
                }

                const consentValue = consent && consent[4] ? consent[4] : "0";
                return consentValue === '1';
            }

            // in case marketing cookie consent is given, hide the content until adobe launch script is loaded and
            // decides about the redirects/etc. As fallback content will be shown in 3 seconds
            if (checkConsent()) {
                const hideContent = document.getElementById('alloy-prehiding');
                if (hideContent && document.location.href.indexOf('adobe_authoring_enabled') === -1) {
                    hideContent.innerText = '.utils-page-fullheight { opacity: 0 !important; }';

                    setTimeout(function () {
                        if (hideContent.parentNode) {
                            hideContent.parentNode.removeChild(hideContent);
                        }
                    }, 3000);
                }
            }
        })();

    </script>

             <p><b>GÖPPINGEN, Germany and SANTA CLARA, Calif. – July 23, 2026 – </b>TeamViewer, a global leader in digital workplace management, and ServiceNow, the AI control tower for business reinvention, today announced a strategic partnership. Under the multi-year agreement, TeamViewer’s market-leading Digital Employee Experience (DEX) and Remote Connectivity solutions will be integrated with the ServiceNow AI Platform. The partnership carries distinct go-to-market benefits with joint dedicated investments to deliver end-to-end autonomous IT solutions.</p>
             <p>Many enterprises today can detect digital friction across their environment but still rely on disconnected tools and manual effort to fix it. This can lead to long resolution times, reduced productivity, and high employee frustration. By integrating TeamViewer’s endpoint technology with the ServiceNow AI Platform, customers can extend their enterprise IT operations from manual intervention toward autonomous management with end-to-end agentic workflows.</p>
             <p>TeamViewer's solutions will be available as a packaged add-on to ServiceNow customers worldwide, supported by implementation and channel partners. The two companies will assign sales and marketing resources to pursue a global go-to-market motion across IT Service Management, Field Service Management, and Customer Service Management. The partnership agreement includes plans to explore deeper integrations and innovation with the intent to expand to new use cases and markets.</p>
             <p>"The future belongs to organizations that can sense, decide, and act in real time," said Bill McDermott, Chairman and CEO, ServiceNow. "By integrating ServiceNow's AI control tower for business reinvention and TeamViewer’s endpoint capabilities, we're closing the loop from insight at the edge to outcomes at scale. Together, we are unlocking autonomous operations, accelerating productivity, and delivering a new era of agentic business."</p>
             <p>"ServiceNow is one of the foremost AI companies in the world and has chosen TeamViewer as a key strategic partner to deliver on its vision of agentic business," said Oliver Steil, TeamViewer Chief Executive Officer. “This is a testament to our leading technology, unique data foundation, and strong innovation roadmap. Together, we intend to make the combined offering indispensable to how the world's largest enterprises run, secure, and automate their operations. It is a partnership built to scale."</p>

"}}" id="text-91d4f2d5ae" class="cmp-text"> Integration of TeamViewer’s endpoint capabilities with the ServiceNow AI Platform to enable end-to-end agentic IT workflows back to overview GÖPPINGEN, Germany and SANTA CLARA, Calif. – July 23, 2026 – TeamViewer, a global leader in digital workplace management, and ServiceNow, the AI control tower for business reinvention, today announced a strategic partnership. Under the multi-year agreement, TeamViewer’s market-leading Digital Employee Experience (DEX) and Remote Connectivity solutions will be integrated with the ServiceNow AI Platform. The partnership carries distinct go-to-market benefits with joint dedicated investments to deliver end-to-end autonomous IT solutions. 
 Many enterprises today can detect digital friction across their environment but still rely on disconnected tools and manual effort to fix it. This can lead to long resolution times, reduced productivity, and high employee frustration. By integrating TeamViewer’s endpoint technology with the ServiceNow AI Platform, customers can extend their enterprise IT operations from manual intervention toward autonomous management with end-to-end agentic workflows. 
 TeamViewer's solutions will be available as a packaged add-on to ServiceNow customers worldwide, supported by implementation and channel partners. The two companies will assign sales and marketing resources to pursue a global go-to-market motion across IT Service Management, Field Service Management, and Customer Service Management. The partnership agreement includes plans to explore deeper integrations and innovation with the intent to expand to new use cases and markets. 
 \"The future belongs to organizations that can sense, decide, and act in real time,\" said Bill McDermott, Chairman and CEO, ServiceNow. \"By integrating ServiceNow's AI control tower for business reinvention and TeamViewer’s endpoint capabilities, we're closing the loop from insight at the edge to outcomes at scale. Together, we are unlocking autonomous operations, accelerating productivity, and delivering a new era of agentic business.\" 
 \"ServiceNow is one of the foremost AI companies in the world and has chosen TeamViewer as a key strategic partner to deliver on its vision of agentic business,\" said Oliver Steil, TeamViewer Chief Executive Officer. “This is a testament to our leading technology, unique data foundation, and strong innovation roadmap. Together, we intend to make the combined offering indispensable to how the world's largest enterprises run, secure, and automate their operations. It is a partnership built to scale.\"

About TeamViewer 
 TeamViewer (XETRA: TMV) resolves digital friction before it disrupts productivity. As AI compounds the sprawl of machines, applications, and agents beyond human reach, TeamViewer restores control: observing endpoint health in real time, acting autonomously to keep technology in its desired state, and guiding operators when human judgment is needed. Its TeamViewer ONE platform unifies endpoint management, digital employee experience, and agentic remote support to lead the shift to autonomous endpoint management (AEM). Built on a structural data advantage from millions of AI-captured expert resolutions, the platform powers self-healing technology and grows more capable with every issue it fixes.
